text: Sun & Sand Sports is a homegrown sports-retail brand of Gulf Marketing Group (GMG), a holding company owned and managed by the Baker family.
short: Sun & Sand Sports is a GMG brand; GMG is owned by the Baker family.

source.name: GMG (Gulf Marketing Group): 'GMG pursues aggressive global expansion in sports retail with RSH acquisition'
source.quote: The GMG Sports portfolio includes homegrown brands such as Sun and Sand Sports
source.note: Same page, 'About Gulf Marketing Group (GMG)': 'Under the ownership and management of the Baker family, it has become one of the Middle East's leading family-owned holding companies.'

additionalSources.name: SGB Media (SGB Executive): 'Sports Direct to Roll Out Stores in Gulf States and Egypt Via GMG Partnership'
additionalSources.quote: GMG has been owned and managed by the Baker family for over 47 years.
additionalSources.note: The same article calls Sun & Sand Sports GMG's 'home-grown multi-brand sports retailer'.
